Description: As a user, I want to securely log into the application so that I can access protected functionality.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid Entra ID token, When I call the API, Then I am signed in with my Entra role. Expired, forged or wrong-audience tokens are rejected (401). Disabled accounts are rejected.

Description: As a user, I want to submit a pest sighting so that I can contribute information to the monitoring system.
Acceptance Criteria: Species, count, description, pin, landmark and postcode are required; time cannot be in the future; anonymous reports need an email; all errors are returned together; valid reports are stored as AwaitingReview with a PP- reference.

Description: As a user, I want to attach an optional photo to my pest report so that I can provide evidence of the sighting.
Acceptance Criteria: JPG/PNG up to 10 MB only; GPS/EXIF data removed; max 3 photos; only the reporter, a worker, or an anonymous reporter with the upload token can attach; submitting without a photo still works.

Title 4: Photo picker in the report form
Test: photo rules and upload API

Description: As a worker, I want to confirm or reject new sightings so that only reliable reports appear on the map.
Acceptance Criteria: Only workers can review; confirm needs a priority; reject needs a reason; a sighting can only be reviewed once; every change is logged.

Description: As a user, I want to view pest activity on a map so that I can understand where pest sightings have occurred.
Acceptance Criteria: Map data comes from stored sightings as GeoJSON; the public map shows only reviewed, open sightings with positions rounded to about 100 m; workers also see unreviewed ones.

Title 4: Angular map page with Azure Maps adapter

Description: As a user, I want to filter pest activity by species so that I can investigate particular pests.
Acceptance Criteria: Filter by species, family, genus, days and visible area; clearing filters shows all sightings again.

Title 4: Map filters (species, family, genus, days, bbox)

Description: As a user, I want to receive an alert when pest activity reaches a significant level so that I can take preventative action.
Acceptance Criteria: High activity (threshold in 30 days), unseasonal and invasive-species alerts are detected; open alerts are updated, not duplicated; only users in the district who consented are notified; failed sends are retried.

Title 4: Test: alert rules, threshold job and sender
